workItems.title: Freeze portable RestClient contracts and shared execution seams
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Implement the approved portable9-method IRestClient surface, guarded immutable five-property RestResult and typed detached context, explicit value-presence/null/empty/truncation semantics, isolated client/call defaults and body/header/query/retry/extension contracts. Fix P04 fault-versus-known-cancellation precedence and W3C correlation mapping. Freeze minimal internal attempt/body-reader/retry/observation/passive-composition seams so transport, extensions, optional retry and collector can compile independently. Preserve native/SDK-free ordinary signatures, exact Core closure and no frameworks or stage graph. Include portable vectors, meaningful contract/architecture tests, docs and independent review.

Review shared ownership, entry-based clock, policy terminal summary and single observation binding before freeze; no fabricated transport/adapter pass.

workItems.title: Implement native HTTP content and resource ownership
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Bind native HttpClient/SocketsHttpHandler/DelegatingHandler and System.Text.Json to fixed Core seams. Preserve one consumption owner and real cleanup, actual completed byte observations and no pool per call. Validate supported owned/factory and borrowed transport settings honestly; preserve TLS, redirect/cookie defaults. No HTTP parser, multipart model or implicit upload buffering; include focused tests/docs/review.
